  "step1_summary": "- Chief complaint: Constant lower abdominal (suprapubic, midline) pain\n- Symptom details: Began a few days ago; constant and worsening; severity ~8/10; localized below the umbilicus, midline; associated with light pink vaginal bleeding/spotting and slight vaginal discharge; nausea without vomiting; prior constipation last week (about 1 week duration) now resolved; currently eating/drinking and doing daily activities but pain is very uncomfortable\n- Aggravating/alleviating factors: Not specified\n- Gynecologic/obstetric: Sexually active (last intercourse ~4 days ago); contraceptive implant (Implanon/Nexplanon) inserted ~1 year ago; menses occur but irregular on implant; last menstrual period ~2–3 weeks ago; last pregnancy test ~1 month ago (no test since pain started); G0 (no prior pregnancies)\n- Urinary: Denies dysuria, foul smell; frequency unclear; no flank pain reported\n- GI: Constipation last week, now improved; no diarrhea; no blood in stool\n- Constitutional: No reported fever, rigors, syncope, shoulder-tip pain, or dyspnea; mild nausea\n- Past medical/surgical history: No surgeries; no chronic conditions reported\n- Medications/allergies: Contraceptive implant; allergy to amoxicillin\n- Family/social history: Lives with husband and his family; school teacher; smoking/alcohol unclear; no recreational drug use; no recent travel (last abroad ~1 year ago)\n- Vitals/exam: Not available (teleconsultation; no physical exam performed)\n- Labs/imaging: None obtained; advised to perform a pregnancy test today",
